newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to continue sell off towards 101.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to continue sell off towards 101.00.

text.p: September LIFFE Bund futures will head down on Tuesday towards the 101.00 area, technical analysts said.
"On Monday it was a bit of a disappointment that we tested the highs in the morning but didn't get through 102.00," said an analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in Frankfurt.
"We saw a good sell-off and that will continue probably down to 101.21 or maybe 101.00."
The 101.00 level was the high on June 6 and comes in around the bottom of the recent trading range.
At 0651 GMT, September Bund futures were at 101.54, up 0.05.
Analysts said the 101.50 area was important on charts being around the mid-point of the recent trading range.
The DMG analyst said initial support came in the 101.20 region, around the 101.22 lows from mid-June. Below 101.00, he said there was a further prop at 100.85.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Markets in London, said critical support from a rising trendline through 101.46 had held on a closing basis on Monday.
"We note with interest the fresh sell signal in Stochastics... and also the key day reversal completed on the close," he said in a note to clients.
Any pullbacks should be used as selling opportunities looking for a test of the 100.94 lows in due course, said Adcock.
To the upside, the DMG analyst saw resistance at 102.20, and said 102.60 was likely to be the highest limit for this session.
He said fundamental factors would influence the market with many German politicians and Bundesbank officials attending the Gloabl 24 conference in Frankfurt on the impact of European monetary union.
At the short end December Euromarks were at 96.73, up one basis point from Monday's close.
